$comment: Single source of truth linking the web-app mutation sheet (web-app/public/mutations.xlsx) to the EDOPro plugin. sheet_name matches the Name column exactly; script names the file in src/cores/, whose stem IS the core id. code is permanent - it is what a host types into Starting LP.

cores.note: LP enforced by script; the 120s clock is a room setting the host must pick.
Turn player recovers at their own Standby Phase.
Enforced as an automatic game loss at startup, not a deck-editor block.
LP enforced by script; the 60s clock is a room setting.

cores.mechanism: EVENT_STARTUP validator: Duel.GetFieldGroupCount(p, LOCATION_DECK, 0) < min_main => Duel.Win(1-p). Same shape as extra_embargo.

cores.note: LP enforced; 30s clock is a room setting; the handtrap ban needs the planned no_hand_effects core.

cores.mechanism: EFFECT_CANNOT_ACTIVATE with a value function rejecting re:GetHandler():IsLocation(LOCATION_HAND). Blocks every handtrap by position rather than by name, so no card list goes stale.
cores.note: Component of Tử Chiến and of the Old-School Clash format in Yêu cầu.txt.

cores.mechanism: EFFECT_CANNOT_SPECIAL_SUMMON with a value function rejecting cards whose previous location is LOCATION_EXTRA. Stopgap available today: extra_embargo with max_extra 0.
cores.note: Blocking the summon reads better than an instant loss, so it gets its own script.

cores.mechanism: EFFECT_CANNOT_SPECIAL_SUMMON for both players. Stopgap available today: high_friction with max_special_summons 0.

lp_code_$comment: Escape hatch past the 13 checkboxes. Starting LP is a uint32 that reaches the duel core untouched (OCG_Player.startingLP), so a host typing base+code into the Host window's Starting LP box selects any core in the library by number. The core then sets the real LP, defaulting to default_lp below.
